features.title: Supabase reader: tables and RLS policies from SQL migrations

acceptance.check: A realistic migrations fixture is read correctly: $$ function and trigger bodies, comments, schema-qualified and quoted names, lowercase keywords, ALTER TABLE ONLY / IF EXISTS, policies FOR ALL and AS RESTRICTIVE, and RLS enabled in a later file.

features.title: Walking skeleton: pnpm monorepo, Next.js app, health endpoint, tests, local Postgres, CI green

acceptance.check: The GitHub Actions verify workflow passes on the latest commit of main, including the CI-only steps (build, gitleaks, semgrep, osv-scanner)

features.title: Code indexer: files, components, exports, imports and routes from TS/JS/TSX

acceptance.check: A symlinked file or folder in the repo (including one pointing outside the repo root or at an ancestor) is never followed or read; it is listed in skipped[] with reason symlink

An import (relative, tsconfig paths or through a symlink) that resolves outside the repo root gets resolved: null, and the output is the same whether or not the outside target exists; relative and tsconfig-path cases are marked outside: true and are never looked up on disk
